scientific_integrity: Original contribution is the double-threshold law and explicit logarithmic rate, not the definition of the kernel, fixed-dimensional moments, or existing angular extreme-value asymptotics. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified Haar-uniform null, normalized off-diagonal pair average, fixed rho in (0,1), and n_d=ceil(exp(alpha d)). At the first transition only a logarithmic limit is proved; no distributional claim at either equality threshold. The finite-dimensional variance is a known supporting fact.
title: Two sharp self-averaging thresholds for a hyperspherical Poisson-kernel uniformity statistic
